standingNegativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.label: HOOK
beats.narration: That pinging sound when you accelerate isn't nothing.
beats.visualPrompt: Close-up of an engine bay at idle, camera slowly pushes in, morning light through a garage door, shallow depth of field.

beats.label: SYMPTOM
beats.narration: A knock or ping under load can point to three different things.
beats.visualPrompt: Driver's-POV dash shot: tachometer needle climbing as the accelerator is applied, road ahead through the windshield, static-mounted camera.

beats.label: EXPLANATION
beats.narration: Carbon buildup in the cylinders. Low-octane fuel. Or a failing knock sensor.
beats.visualPrompt: Macro/cutaway sequence: a fuel nozzle at a pump, cut to a cylinder-head cutaway model showing carbon deposits, cut to a knock sensor mounted on an engine block, slow push-in on each.

beats.label: DIAGNOSTIC_CLUE
beats.narration: One clue: does it only happen climbing hills or towing? That's worth checking first.
beats.visualPrompt: Close-up of an OBD-II scan tool clipped under the dash, screen glowing with diagnostic codes, engine bay softly reflected in a nearby window, static mount.

beats.label: CONSEQUENCE
beats.narration: Ignoring it can let engine damage build quietly. Don't guess which one it is.
beats.visualPrompt: Dashboard shot: the check-engine light glowing amber against a dim instrument cluster, subtle flicker, static hold.

beats.label: BRANDED_CTA
beats.narration: Stop by and we'll take a look before it gets expensive. Nick's Tire & Auto.
beats.visualPrompt: Branded end-card plate: Nick's Tire & Auto shop bay wide shot, warm daylight, slow static push-in. Real logo and CTA text composited in post.

beats.label: SAVE_FREEZE
beats.visualPrompt: Same end-card plate, continued slow push-in (not a hard freeze, to satisfy the render-integrity motion floor).
